# One ticket many clocks

## The heuristic

**When an entitlement creates more than one clock on a ticket, decide up front which one the ticket is judged on.**


_Why:_ Left undecided, the ticket will be judged retroactively on whichever clock was met, by whoever is writing the report. That is not a metric, it is a narrative.
